svg.title: ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1 REV2 pinout for PinballTimer
svg.desc: REV2 GPIO pin map for the PinballTimer's ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1 module (confirmed, physical board not yet built): TFT and Display 4 moved off J1/J3 header pins that double as UART0 or were previously button pins, an MCP23017 I2C expander added for the 5 button switches + 5 button lights, and which GPIOs become fully free as a result. Includes the MCP23017's own bank A/B pin assignments.
svg.text: PinballTimer REV2 Pinout (confirmed — board not yet built)
Same ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1 header layout as REV1 (J1 left, J3 right) — colors mark what changed. MCP23017 bank map below.

g.text: MCP23017 (I2C expander, assumed address 0x20) — driven from GPIO17/18 above
BANK A — inputs, internal pull-ups (button switches)
BANK B — outputs, via ULN2803A (button lights)
A0-A2 wired directly to GND (address 0x20, confirmed). VDD 3.3V (matches ESP32 logic). SDA/SCL need their own 4.7-10k pull-ups to 3.3V.
Freed by REV2 (was used in REV1)

svg.text: REV2 pin table confirmed; physical board and MCP23017 firmware backend done and compiling (pio run -e app-rev2) but not yet flashed to real hardware. See CLAUDE.md "REV2 hardware".
